summary: Tested multi-connection booking flow for Kirmes module. Most features working correctly, but found a pricing bug for Wohnwagen signups.

critical.issue: Wohnwagen signups use regular prices instead of wohnwagen_prices. When a Wohnwagen signup has connection_type='Schuko', it uses 30 EUR (regular Schuko price) instead of 50 EUR (wohnwagen Schuko price). The backend checks regular prices first and only falls back to wohnwagen_prices if no match found.
critical.fix_suggestion: Check if fahrgeschaeft === 'Wohnwagen' and use wohnwagen_prices for those signups

ui_bugs.issue: Wohnwagen signups show wrong price in Buchungsübersicht. Uses regular Schuko price (30 EUR) instead of wohnwagen Schuko price (50 EUR)
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: When calculating price for Wohnwagen signups (isWohnwagen=true), search wohnwagen_prices first

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Backend - In POST /api/kirmes/public/signup, check if fahrgeschaeft === 'Wohnwagen' and use wohnwagen_prices for price lookup
FIX HIGH: Frontend - In Buchungsübersicht calculation, for Wohnwagen signups (isWohnwagen=true), search wohnwagen_prices first before regular prices
critical_code_review_comments: Backend kirmes.py line 928-938: Price lookup logic doesn't distinguish between regular and Wohnwagen signups. Both use same connection_type (e.g., 'Schuko') but have different prices.
Frontend SchaustellerAnmeldungPage.jsx line 839: allPrices combines both price lists with regular prices first, causing wrong price display for Wohnwagen

success_rate.backend: 95% - All APIs working, pricing bug for Wohnwagen
success_rate.frontend: 95% - All UI flows working, pricing display bug for Wohnwagen
